title: No automatic HNSW connectivity guard — degradation is only visible to an operator eyeballing partition stats
wanted_capability: Operational wiring for the connectivity diagnostics shipped with gap-2eabd96d. The compaction cron gates on deleted_ratio only, so the 17% disconnection incident was invisible to every automatic path — it was caught by an operator reading partition stats in a hybrid_search response. Wanted: (a) feed zero_in_degree_nodes / disconnected_nodes ratio into the compaction policy gate (compose with gap-bfe61876 multi-partition ticks) so a partition whose connectivity degrades past a threshold gets a rebuild scheduled; (b) surface threshold breaches through bbox_inbox so the attention layer sees vector-recall risk; (c) expose HnswIndex::self_recall_probe(sample_every, k) on an operational surface (bbox_storage_health or embed status) — today it is a method only, callable by nothing. The graph degrades under incremental push (the diversity-shrink fix slows this massively but exact-duplicate degeneracy still orphans ~1% on real corpora and regrowth is plausible); without a guard, the next regression repeats the silent-for-weeks pattern.
missing_primitive: Connectivity-ratio trigger in the compaction policy + self_recall_probe MCP exposure
evidence: compaction gate: compact_partitions_with_policy deleted_ratio threshold only
